name: Machine Chest Press
steps: Adjust the seat until the handles are level with the middle of your chest, then sit with your feet flat.
Set your upper back against the pad and grip the handles with straight wrists and elbows slightly below shoulder height.
Press the handles forward smoothly until your arms are extended without locking your elbows hard.
Bring the handles slowly back toward your chest until you feel a comfortable stretch across your pecs.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades pinned back against the pad instead of rolling your shoulders forward at the end of the press.
Keep your wrists aligned directly behind your knuckles throughout the movement.
